products.notes: Short-read 30x WGS; 530+ reports; includes 3 months tellmeGen+ subscription. Downloads: FASTQ, CRAM (not BAM), VCF, plus MyVariants CSV. 3 free downloads/year, then EUR/USD 4.99 each. Duo and family multi-kit bundles also sold.

ships_to: Ships by UPS or DHL to nearly every country, including the US. The sample must return from the country where it was bought. Remote places and islands may face limits or delays.
turnaround: 4-6 weeks after sample received at lab; kit ships in 2-4 business days
verification_summary: Verified operating as of 2026-08-28: all three tiers (Starter array $94.99, Advanced array $159.99, Ultra WGS 30x $329.99 USD) show InStock with working add-to-cart on the en-US Shopify store; a SUMMEREND10 -10% promo runs until Sep 15. Raw-data formats confirmed from tellmeGen's own support article (updated Apr 2026): CSV for array kits; FASTQ, CRAM, VCF and CSV for Ultra (BAM is NOT offered; 3 free downloads/year then ~$4.99 each). No US state exclusions (NY/NJ/RI/MD) found anywhere in their FAQ, shipping policy, or terms; the only US-specific restriction found is that the pharmacogenetics report section is unavailable in the US. Prices are region-dependent (EUR on EU storefront); USD prices quoted are from the en-US store today.

name: YSEQ
data_practices_note: YSEQ says it does not sell or rent personal data. Research sharing needs a separate opt-in form and uses data with names removed or grouped. Consent cannot be withdrawn after it is given. Some processing happens in the US.

products.notes: 100/150bp paired-end reads; free BAM download; Y-SNPs annotated to VCF from Ybrowse; all raw data downloadable free or on 128GB microSD (+60 EUR). ~half stated coverage on Y chromosome.
